name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: generate_marketing_strategy
prompts.template: Create a detailed marketing strategy for the following objectives: {marketing_task_description} targeting {target_audience_data} focused on {discipline_selection}.
prompts.use_case: Launching multi-channel marketing campaigns with AI-generated content and strategy

prompts.name: audit_content_quality
prompts.template: Evaluate the following marketing content using the TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, and RAMP gates: {content_assets}.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing SEO and GEO targeting through AI-driven analysis and content placement

prompts.name: optimize_campaign
prompts.template: Based on these performance metrics {performance_metrics}, provide recommendations to improve our marketing campaign.
prompts.use_case: Conducting influencer marketing strategies integrated with automated auditing for impact

prompts.name: generate_campaign_assets
prompts.template: Produce marketing content suitable for {discipline_selection} discipline for the campaign: {marketing_task_description}.
prompts.use_case: Email campaign automation with AI-crafted messaging and performance audits
